</role>
<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that reporting periods cannot be locked, risking double-counted payments. I checked the five most similar items: story 4137 'Reporting navigation' (unstarted) and its Notion roadmap counterpart both concern navigation, not period locking; 4127 (bulk upload), 4136 (supplier addresses), and 4131 (workspace administration) are unrelated problems. No completed story or roadmap item addresses locking reporting periods, so the problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
